mainText: How a football team rebuilt after 19 players died in plane crash. How a Brazilian football team rose again after a plane crash that killed most of their players and staff on the way to what should have been the biggest match of their lives. Gibbs-White scores twice as Forest beat struggling Chelsea. Igor Jesus' stunning volley and two goals from Morgan Gibbs-White help Nottingham Forest beat a struggling Chelsea side, who lose their third Premier League game in a row. 'You're not welcome here' - fans turn on Fofana as Chelsea lose again. Chelsea defender Wesley Fofana is booed by his own fans during the Premier League defeat at Nottingham Forest after a controversial interview.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Argentina's bid to stop Falklands oil drilling rejected. A joint venture between UK-Israeli companies is set to start exploring for oil and gas, but Argentina sought to block it as part of its claim to sovereignty. Pensions and benefits services still down after 'cyber incident'. The UK's former chief technology officer says the Department for Work and Pensions may have been hit by hackers, but the government has not confirmed that. Man arrested on suspicion of murder of girl, 16. A man is arrested on suspicion murdering a 16-year-old girl who died in east London on Friday. Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says. The Israeli military says it targeted "Hamas terrorists" in the strike which has been condemned by the World Health Organization.
